'''Pisquatch's Place''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located a few blocks down from [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's]] on [[Outer Kerner Way]], [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="renegade" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], along with Skywalker's Tatooine friends [[Windy Starkiller]], [[Jaxson]], [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Fixer]] and [[Camie Loneozner]], once celebrated in the cantina to commemorate Skywalker and Jaxson's survival in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="renegade" />

A garish painting of [[Noosh Feteel]], one of Mos Eisley's founding fathers, was displayed in the cantina.<ref name="renegade" />
